title: A measurement offers a corner radius it has nothing to round
goal: Pick a measurement and the Appearance section offers a Corner Radius slider, under the parts that paint it. A caliper and its readout chip have no corners the slider reaches: pulling it does nothing you can see. Take the row off a measurement, so the section never offers a control that cannot answer.
notes: Seen on the probe on 2026-09-09 while building a-measurement-s-parts-live-in-appearance-like-ev, and visible in every screenshot of that audit: queue/audits/2026-09-09-measure-parts-1-panel-sc.png shows Corner Radius 0 px under Chip Text on a picked measurement. Reproduce with Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/measure-parts-walk.json and look at measure-parts-1-panel-sc.png. Not caused by that work: the row comes from EditorState.corneredRadiusSelection, which calls document.cornerRadiusSelection(layerIDs:cornersOnly:true) and evidently counts a measure layer as cornered. The fix belongs in whatever cornersOnly tests, in PhotonzCore, with a test first.
acceptance: A picked measurement shows no Corner Radius row in Appearance
A picked rectangle, frame, picture and label still show theirs, unchanged
A measurement picked together with a rectangle shows the row for the rectangle and says it reaches one of the two
